task.title: Define RED tests for the Echolet CLI command surface
task.description: Create failing process-level tests for init, contact export/import, relay publish, send, poll, history, and doctor commands with stable JSON output, exit codes, prompts, and redaction.
task.scope: apps/cli command parser, entrypoint, and process-level contract tests

acceptance_criteria: All documented commands accept --profile and reject unknown flags or missing values with exit code 2.
Contact import requires an explicit interactive confirmation or an explicit noninteractive fingerprint/confirmation option suitable for E2E automation.
--json emits exactly one valid result object on stdout while diagnostics use stderr and contain no store key, private key, session material, or message plaintext.
Trust/protocol rejection maps to exit 3, temporary relay/network failure to 4, persistence failure to 5, and success to 0.
init refuses to replace an existing profile; contact and doctor commands operate without network; send/poll/history delegate to the completed runtime services.
Package bin metadata and built/runnable entrypoint support two independent child processes on Node 22.13+.
constraints: Load and follow tests-creator and the project testing skill; preserve RED-before-GREEN evidence.
Read completed T24 and T25 implementation/results before finalizing command mocks and adapters.
Do not write implementation code or weaken existing tests; do not edit flow.json or acceptance-criteria.md.
Use keryx ctx rg for searches and apply_patch for edits.
Use spawn/execFile process tests for output and exit-code contracts; never place secret values in assertion messages or persisted fixtures.
Do not commit because the repository has an unborn untracked baseline.
Write and validate a subagent-result to .metaproject/flows/001-2026-09-05-echolet-assessment-fixes/dispatches/001-T30-tests-result.json; final response starts STATUS:.

provenance.source_request: Implement the approved Echolet CLI prototype through flow-orchestrator.
